description: This file defines a utility class ObjectUtils that provides static methods for working with JsonObject instances, such as checking for boolean or string entries, creating JSON objects containing boolean values, and serializing boolean values to strings. The class is designed to facilitate handling of JSON objects within the project.
external_files: JsonObject (likely defined in a related JSON library)
Core::JSON::Variant (part of a JSON handling library)

classes.name: ObjectUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manipulate JSON objects, particularly for handling boolean and string entries.
